primary.title: India bond yields above 7%: Why debt fund investors may find a sweet spot in the 3–5 year segment
primary.summary: Indian bond yields have crossed 7%, raising the question of where debt investors should look. Axis MF favours the 3–5-year segment, particularly high-quality corporate bonds and select SDLs, while remaining cautious on long-duration debt amid oil, inflation, and global rate risks.
